correctness.rationale: The claimed map g->F(g) follows from an explicit bijection between ordered rank-two transvection factorizations and nonisotropic lines of the Wall quadratic Q_g, after separate exhaustive rank-zero and rank-one cases. All finite-field symmetric-binary, SL_2 rational eigenline and ambient two-plane counts are derived in RESULT.md; coefficient identities sum to (q^(2m)-1)^2. A standard-library checker, replayed from the packaged verify.py, directly enumerates every ordered pair in ten finite cases including extension fields and compares rank/Wall fibers and support. This validates cases but universal correctness rests on the written algebraic proof. No external certification or infinite computation is claimed.

value.rationale: A fixed generating class square in the finite symplectic group is a canonical first convolution and class-algebra structure invariant. The theorem computes every elementwise factorization number and the full positive/zero rank-two multiplicity census uniformly in arbitrary symplectic rank and all finite-field characteristics, reveals an actual characteristic-two alternating-Wall-form obstruction and the q=2 rank-one exclusion, and refines prior mere existence/minimal-factor-length and structural stability theorems. Those properties make the detailed exact count mathematically motivated rather than an arbitrary finite enumeration.
